articles.title: Govt green-lights plan to buy 114 French Rafale jets
articles.summary: India has approved a multibillion-dollar deal with France to acquire and jointly manufacture 114 Rafale fighter jets. This strategic move aims to critically bolster India's air defence capabilities, addressing existing shortfalls. The acquisition enhances the Indian Air Force's operational readiness and strengthens bilateral defence cooperation, vital for national security and regional stability.
